svg.text: Arduino-Based Real-Time WIP Monitoring and Bottleneck Detection · Arduino UNO + 6 FC-51 + SG90 + NodeMCU ESP8266
+5V goes ONLY to the servo red wire.
Its - joins the shared GND rail.
Each LED: pin → resistor → long leg; short leg → GND rail
(short-leg wires to GND not drawn, to keep it readable)
A0 → 220 Ω → S3 red LED → GND
powered by its own micro-USB (laptop or power bank)
RX ← from UNO A3 via divider
UNO A3 (TX, 5 V) → 1 kΩ → ● → NodeMCU D5 · ● → 2.2 kΩ → GND (≈3.4 V, safe for the ESP8266)
NodeMCU D6 (3.3 V) → UNO A2 directly: the UNO reads 3.3 V as HIGH
Rules: 1) every GND is connected together.
2) never power the servo from the UNO 5V pin.
3) never feed 5 V straight into a NodeMCU pin.
